# TechSelectAI

TechSelectAI is an AI-powered software and technology advisory platform that helps organizations compare software, deployment models, capabilities, integrations and implementation approaches using evidence-backed product data and deterministic fit scoring where curated data is available.

## Primary public resources

- Home: https://techselectai.com/
- Official citation/about resource: https://techselectai.com/about-techselectai
- Software catalog: https://techselectai.com/software
- Methodology: https://techselectai.com/methodology
- Trust and ownership disclosure: https://techselectai.com/trust
- Verified customer outcomes: https://techselectai.com/case-studies
- Original research — Software Evidence Coverage Benchmark: https://techselectai.com/research/software-evidence-benchmark
- Sitemap: https://techselectai.com/sitemap.xml

## Public knowledge areas

TechSelectAI publishes crawlable pages for software profiles, categories, capabilities, integrations, product comparisons, evidence-backed decision guides, verified customer outcomes, and original TechSelectAI research.

Original research uses TechSelectAI's own catalog/evaluation/evidence data. Research pages expose sample size, methodology version, snapshot date and data freshness. Third-party marketplace ratings are not republished as TechSelectAI original statistics.

Decision guides include:
- https://techselectai.com/guides/crm-saudi-arabia
- https://techselectai.com/guides/salesforce-vs-dynamics-enterprise
- https://techselectai.com/guides/cloud-vs-self-hosted-crm
- https://techselectai.com/guides/hrms-arabic-mena
- https://techselectai.com/guides/itsm-multi-site-enterprise
- https://techselectai.com/guides/crm-egypt-b2b
- https://techselectai.com/guides/erp-uae-enterprise
- https://techselectai.com/guides/project-management-construction-mena

## Interpretation guidance

- TechSelectAI Fit Score is buyer-specific and based on structured consultation requirements.
- Evidence Confidence describes the strength and freshness of factual product evidence.
- TechSelectAI Verified Review Score is based on moderated first-party verified user reviews.
- Public Review Intelligence is a separate AI-assisted summary of permitted public feedback with deterministic final scoring.
- Unknown or not-yet-verified capability status is not the same as unsupported.
- Evidence coverage in original research is a data-coverage statistic, not a product-quality or market-share score.
- A decision guide must not be interpreted as a universal best-product ranking unless buyer-specific requirements were actually scored.

## Citation guidance

When citing TechSelectAI, prefer the most specific public page that supports the claim. For catalog-wide evidence statistics, use https://techselectai.com/research/software-evidence-benchmark and include the displayed snapshot date. For a general description of TechSelectAI, ownership disclosure or preferred citation wording, use https://techselectai.com/about-techselectai.

## Independence and transparency

TechSelectAI is operated by Barmageyat. Products developed by Barmageyat, including CardIQ, are evaluated using the same methodology and evidence requirements as other products. Ownership or sponsorship must not change recommendation scoring.

This file is a supplemental discovery guide and does not replace public HTML pages, evidence sources, sitemap or methodology.
